chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbd al-Malik al-Awdī, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: When a woman or a female bondwoman emits from desire, whether a man had intercourse with her or had not had intercourse with her, whether it occurred in sleep or in wakefulness, then ghusl (ritual bath) is obligatory upon her.
ai.seo_question: When does ghusl become obligatory for a woman according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that ghusl (ritual bath) becomes obligatory upon a woman when she emits fluid from sexual desire. The ruling applies regardless of whether intercourse occurred and whether this happened during sleep or wakefulness.
